definitions.gloss: to get to the heart of the matter; to hit the nail on the head
definitions.explanation: To identify or address the most important, central point of an issue. Used when someone makes a remark or asks a question that goes straight to the core of a problem.

examples.japanese: {核心|かくしん}を{突|つ}く⟦{質問|しつもん}→質問：00888_shitsumon⟧だった。
examples.english: It was a question that hit the nail on the head.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{発言|はつげん}→発言：05099_hatsugen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{核心|かくしん}→核心：13105_kakushin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{突|つ}いて→突く：12735_tsuku⟧⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Her remark got to the heart of the problem.

examples.japanese: ⟦{記者|きしゃ}→記者：14170_kisha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{核心|かくしん}を{突|つ}く⟦{質問|しつもん}→質問：00888_shitsumon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{大臣|だいじん}→大臣：03417_daijin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{明確|めいかく}→明確：01664_meikaku⟧な⟦{回答|かいとう}→回答：00142_kaitou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{避|さ}けた→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧。
examples.english: The reporter asked a pointed question that went to the heart of the matter, but the minister avoided giving a clear answer.

notes:
USAGE:
{核心|かくしん}を{突|つ}く is used when someone identifies the central, most important point of an issue. It is often used to describe incisive questions, remarks, or analyses. The verb ⟦{突|つ}く→突く：12735_tsuku⟧ conjugates as godan: ⟦{突|つ}く→突く：12735_tsuku⟧ → ⟦{突|つ}いた→突く：12735_tsuku⟧ → ⟦{突|つ}いて→突く：12735_tsuku⟧.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {核心|かくしん}を{突|つ}く⟦{質問|しつもん}→質問：00888_shitsumon⟧ (a question that gets to the heart of the matter)
- {核心|かくしん}を{突|つ}く⟦{発言|はつげん}→発言：05099_hatsugen⟧ (a remark that hits the mark)
- ⟦{核心|かくしん}→核心：13105_kakushin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{突|つ}いた→突く：12735_tsuku⟧⟦{指摘|してき}→指摘：05630_shiteki⟧ (an observation that identifies the core issue)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{的|まと}→的：19356_mato⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{射|い}る (to hit the mark — similar but broader)
- ⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧⟦ところ→所：01137_tokoro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{突|つ}く→突く：12735_tsuku⟧ (to touch a sore spot — more personal/uncomfortable)
